description: This PHP class, ConfigDao, serves as a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing configuration settings within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to set, retrieve, and list configuration key-value pairs stored in a database.

classes.name: ConfigDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for CRUD operations related to configuration entries in the system.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a configuration key to a given value, creating a new entry if it does not exist.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific configuration key.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Returns an associative array of all configuration key-value pairs.
